newsitem.title: CHINA: China Dalian grain terminal sets equipment tender.
newsitem.headline: China Dalian grain terminal sets equipment tender.

text.p: China's northeastern port of Dalian has invited bids on supplies of equipment for the Xizui grain terminal, officials said on Wednesday.

They said Dalian Beiliang Co Ltd is seeking two sets of ship loaders, each with a capacity of 2,000 tonnes per hour, and two sets of ship unloaders, each with a capacity of 1,000 tonnes per hour, and one mechanical and electric control system.

The officials, contacted by telephone, declined to give an indication of the expected cost of the equipment though they said the project would be partly financed by credits from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the World Bank's main lending arm.
Bids on the international tender must be submitted by July 9. CMC International Tendering Co is acting as agent.
